objective: Allocate integer path rates under every capacity-domain dependency using deterministic weighted max-min progressive filling and source-qualified fresh capacity observations.

mathematical_contract.resource_constraint: sum(x_path_bps for paths that traverse domain d) <= capacity_domain_d_bps
mathematical_contract.rounding: deterministic one-bit adjustments by lowest normalized service above floor, then path ID

scenarios.name: independent-paths
scenarios.purpose: all path rates reach their demand ceilings without shared resource overcommitment

scenarios.name: shared-backhaul
scenarios.purpose: different access links consume one shared backhaul ceiling

scenarios.name: overlap-plus-independent
scenarios.purpose: shared pair freezes while an independent path continues filling

scenarios.name: overlap-chain
scenarios.purpose: A-X, B-X-Y, C-Y; only paths using a binding domain freeze

scenarios.name: demand-limited-release
scenarios.purpose: a demand-limited path releases its unused entitlement to remaining backlogged paths

scenarios.name: weighted-1-2-4
scenarios.purpose: exact 1:2:4 weighted max-min allocation on one shared resource

scenarios.name: feasible-service-floors
scenarios.purpose: all per-path floors honoured before residual sharing

scenarios.name: infeasible-shared-floor
scenarios.purpose: sum of floors above one shared capacity returns an explicit error

scenarios.name: missing-capacity
scenarios.purpose: referenced domain without a capacity observation is rejected

scenarios.name: invalid-domain-set
scenarios.purpose: blank, duplicate, empty or oversized domain sets are rejected

scenarios.name: input-permutation
scenarios.purpose: path and capacity input order does not change the report

scenarios.name: integer-remainder
scenarios.purpose: one-bit residual is assigned deterministically without resource overcommitment

scenarios.name: distinct-source-digests
scenarios.purpose: per-domain source digests are preserved and not conflated

scenarios.name: capacity-overflow-boundary
scenarios.purpose: checked arithmetic and all domain ceilings hold at upper bounds

explicit_non_claims: This allocator is not a general-purpose LP or multi-commodity-flow solver.
Weighted max-min is the declared allocation policy, not a universal global sum-rate optimum.
Capacity-domain observations are caller-supplied and are not inferred or authenticated by this module.
Different providers, IP addresses or radio interfaces do not prove independent capacity.
A deterministic allocation result is not a measured kernel qdisc or MPTCP scheduler result.
The allocator does not change routes, sockets, qdiscs or packet scheduling.
No claim is made that this module beats CAKE, fq_codel, MPTCP congestion control or a carrier scheduler.
Benchmark targets are proposals and have not yet been measured.
